mapper.sql: FROM wf_task t JOIN wf_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id AND i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.assignee_id AND u.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN sys_user starter ON starter.id = i.starter_id AND starter.tenant_id = i.tenant_id
WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.assignee_id = #{userId} AND i.deleted = 0 AND t.status IN ('PENDING', 'SENT') AND (i.project_id IS NULL OR i.project_id IN #{id})AND i.project_id IS NULL

SELECT t.id, t.instance_id, t.task_key, t.node_id, t.task_type, t.task_group_key, t.status, COALESCE(t.assignee_name, u.display_name) AS assignee_name, t.created_at, i.business_key, i.business_type, i.business_title, i.business_round, i.project_ref, i.project_name, i.action_path, starter.display_name AS starter_name, i.status AS instance_status
mapper.select: AND (t.created_at < #{cursorCreatedAt} OR (t.created_at = #{cursorCreatedAt} AND t.id < #{cursorId})) ORDER BY t.created_at DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{size}
